create_encoder_subclass: create a subclass of FairseqEncoder that implements forward and reorder_encoder_out methods
implement_forward_pass: implement the forward method in a FairseqEncoder subclass to process src_tokens and src_lengths
reorder_encoder_output: reorder encoder output tensors according to a new batch order using reorder_encoder_out
use_torchscript_forward: use forward_torchscript to run a TorchScript-compatible forward pass on net_input dictionary
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade an old model state_dict to work with newer FairseqEncoder code using upgrade_state_dict_named
